task_description: Implement the `fastai_check_env` CLI feature from FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (line 57) in the IngridMorstrad/fastai fork: a one-step environment validator for GPU drivers, CUDA version, and dependency compatibility. Follow the fork's hand-authored-module pattern (standalone fastai/check_env.py + tests/test_check_env.py, no notebook, no _modidx.py entry) and register a console_scripts entry in settings.ini. The only CI gate is nbdev sync; the change must not introduce a sync diff. Commit on a feature branch off master; do not push or open the PR.

verification.summary: Verified independently on the CI-matching Python 3.11 env (.venv311, nbdev 3.3.25, fastcore 2.2.32). CI gate: `python -m nbdev.export` then `git status --porcelain -uno` is EMPTY (zero sync diff). `import fastai.check_env` succeeds with torch NOT installed. `pytest tests/test_check_env.py` = 24 passed with no GPU/torch (torch mocked via sys.modules). CLI smoke test: human-readable report + exit 0 when compatible; --json emits valid JSON with 23 checks. Diff vs master = only fastai/check_env.py, tests/test_check_env.py, settings.ini (+ .agents state); FEATURE_REQUESTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/BUGS.md unmodified. Test quality: tests inject a fake torch into sys.modules to drive CUDA paths and monkeypatch _dist_version to exercise OK/ERROR/INFO/WARNING constraint branches and main() exit codes; they would fail if the implementation were reverted. Full `pytest tests/` has 14 pre-existing collection errors solely from missing heavy deps (numpy/torch not installed), not regressions. No pytest job in CI; CI == nbdev sync, which passes.
